overview.name: Goldman Sachs Income P
overview.description: The fund invests, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes (“Net Assets”) in fixed income securities. A fixed income security is a debt instrument issued by a company, government or other entity to borrow money.
